title: Interlaminar Analysis of Aluminum Matrix Reinforced with SiC Particles by Microscopy Techniques
content: The transportation industry, particularly the aerospace sector, continually seeks innovative strategies to reduce aircraft weight while maintaining structural integrity, through the development and optimization of advanced materials and composites. A key aspect of this effort is the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes to enhance the strength and stiffness of lightweight materials, such as polymers and aluminum, magnesium, and titanium alloys.
